consentModal.title: Your Privacy Settings
consentModal.description: Our website uses various third-party services to enhance your browsing experience. Some are essential for the functionality of the website, while others help us analyze usage, display embedded content, and provide personalized features. You can choose which services you would like to allow.

sections.title: Use of third-party services
sections.description: Our website uses various third-party services to enhance your browsing experience. Some are essential for the functionality of the website, while others help us analyze usage, display embedded content, and provide personalized features. You can choose which services you would like to allow.

sections.title: Necessary Always active
sections.description: These third-party services are essential for the basic functionality and security of our website. Processing is based on our legitimate interest to provide you with a functional and secure website. These necessary services cannot be disabled, as the website would not function properly without them.

sections.title: Legitimate Interest
sections.description: Processing is based on our legitimate interest to provide you with a functional and secure website.

sections.title: Functionality
sections.description: These third-party services enable comfort and personalization. They may be set by us or by third parties whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these services, some or all of these services may not function properly.

sections.title: Analytics Services
sections.description: These third-party services allow us to count visitors and analyze the use of the website. This helps us measure and improve the performance of our website. All information these services collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous.

body.name: _ga_*, _gid
body.description: Collects anonymized data about website usage for visitor statistics and usage analysis.

sections.title: Advertising
sections.description: These services allow us to show you personalized advertising tailored to your interests. This enables us to measure and improve the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns.

sections.title: More Information
sections.description: For questions about the use of third-party services and cookies and your choices, please contact us.
